verdict.rationale: The evidence documents single-line CLI install routes an agent could run from a shell: `claude plugin install mattpocock-skills@claude-plugins-official`, the codex and copilot plugin marketplace commands, and `npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills`. However, nothing says these are promptless. The npx installer has you 'pick the skills and agents you use', and the post-install setup skill asks which issue tracker to use, so a fully headless end-to-end path is not established. Missing for 10: explicit non-interactive/--yes flags for the npx installer, documentation that the plugin installs need no prompts, a way to run setup configuration without interaction, and hands-on corroboration of an agent installing headlessly.
